items.title: Duffy Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 17, 1995
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' (likely Monk Masikini, the interviewer), not the jazz pianist Thelonious Monk. No personal relationship with Thelonious Monk is described.

ctx.x: And it’s a great pleasure to have you here.
Would you like to tell us about what you were doing today?
